items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: We all went in this fellow's garage and paid our dues and things like that.

ctx.x: Do you know what year that 767 was formed (inaudible)?
No, I don't. It was before me, because they didn't have a house, or they didn't have an office. We all went in this fellow's garage and paid our dues and things like that.
